title: I'm Obsessed With My Little Bro!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A high-school student council president who seems perfect is privately consumed by an over-the-top obsession with her younger brother. Episodic gag comedy surrounds the siblings with eccentric side characters, and reviewers say a later arc turns serious, including a threatened sexual assault on the sister.
life_message: Family bonds, however awkward, are worth protecting, and people are more than their public image.

content.note: Reviewers mention slapstick violence and over-the-top reactions.
Reviewer describes a later arc with a threatened sexual assault on the sister (MU user review; MU categories).
Older sister's obsessive, incest-tinged crush on her brother played as innuendo and perverse fantasy (MU Incest, Ecchi; user reviews; MangaDex suggestive). Not explicit per reviews.
Yandere-style fixation and a 'mentally-disturbed' friend played for comedy (MU categories; blurb).
Stealing a sibling's clothes and boundary-crossing presented as jokes (user review).
